idConvention: Catalog entries keep their INV-0xx id; other entries use UIF- (field), UIA- (action), UIR- (region) and cite the requirement or journey that needs them. The id is also the Limen binding/event name.

capabilityBoundaries.DataVisible: repository status, summaries, metadata, stored records, loading/error states; no replay claimed (Types.fs Visible<T>)
capabilityBoundaries.DataUnderstood: domain-engine projections: hypotheses, evidence, relationships, timeline, conclusions, state (Types.fs Understood<T>); no conversion from Visible exists
capabilityBoundaries.DataEditable: inputs, commands, validation, save progress, conflict and unknown outcome (InvestigationEditor.fs, UiIntent)

screens.purpose: Before Connect: an accessible, empty, disconnected workspace with the explicit Connect data repository action. After Connect: the connected repository's investigations and the user's working copies.

catalogEntries.name: Link evidence to a hypothesis
catalogEntries.notes: The link is shown on both the evidence and the hypothesis, and survives a reload. A link to a non-existent target is refused. At most one current assessment per evidence-hypothesis pair: a second link for the pair is refused, pointing to the existing one. Reassessing or withdrawing keeps the earlier assessment and its provenance in the history (OD-INDY-23).
catalogEntries.placementBasis: J2-03..J2-06 (link editor used from Evidence)

catalogEntries.name: Evidence relationship kind
catalogEntries.notes: A Forma choice group with no option selected initially. supports: makes the hypothesis more credible; contradicts: makes it less credible; consistent-with: fits but does not favour it over competing hypotheses it also fits; inconclusive: assessed, but whether it fits cannot yet be determined. Not assessed is the absence of a relationship, never an option (OD-INDY-23, docs/rehearsal-009-content-readiness/HYPOTHESIS-EVIDENCE-RELATIONSHIPS.md).
catalogEntries.placementBasis: J2-03..J2-06 (link editor used from Evidence)

catalogEntries.name: Record a conclusion

catalogEntries.name: All content survives a reload from GitHub
catalogEntries.notes: After verified persistence, a reload from the real GitHub repository in a new browser context shows every entered value (the INVESTIGATION-CONTENT-E2E scenario, docs/rehearsal-009-content-readiness/E2E-VERIFICATION.md).
catalogEntries.placementBasis: workflow outcome, judged by J1/J2 reload

catalogEntries.name: Evidence relationship rationale
catalogEntries.notes: Required for every assessment, including a reassessment; a withdrawal records its own reason. The rationale is the recorded inference that separates the evidence from what it is taken to mean.

catalogEntries.notes: A nav region with Overview, Causal Analysis, Evidence, Hypotheses and Timeline (Corrective Actions where supported).
